notes: Added FEHA_UNIQUE_WEAPON_CATALOG.js v1.0.0 for the seven one-off weapons in Do these/-Other without changing the permanent reviewed 78-gun manufacturer catalog.
Ghost Key now shorts and opens doors/locks on hit; Motor Lock stops hit vehicles dead; Optic Zero can blank electronic/cybernetic vision.
Igla Sovereign is the outlaw double-barrel: 40d2 base damage with a six-shot Sovereign Overload cycle followed by a one-turn cooldown.
Silverhand 3516 is the best-in-slot Heavy Pistol at 1d30+75 and requires Gorilla Arms to fire.
Shovel Caretaker is intentionally just a 1d6 bludgeoning shovel.
Slaughtomatic uses 100d100-9000 damage, floors negative totals to 0 by rule text, has 12 sealed shots, and cannot be reloaded.
Unique weapons are flagged Weapons_Unique and marketReady=false so they never enter ordinary random Market stock.
ADK DEV LOADER now preflights, contract-checks, migrates, and hot-rerenders the seven unique weapons.
